Snowflake for Healthcare & Life Sciences

## Frequently Asked Questions

Commonly asked questions and their answers to support your data and AI journey with Snowflake.

What are the advantages of cloud solutions for healthcare and life sciences?

Cloud platforms give healthcare and life sciences organizations a secure, scalable foundation to unify data, reduce costs and accelerate innovation. The following are some of the key advantages organizations in this industry can take advantage of.

- **Aggregate siloed data:** Eliminate data silos by unifying disparate sources (EHRs, claims, genomics) into a single source of truth. This produces better insights that power downstream use cases like care delivery and operational efficiency.

- **Tap into a connected ecosystem:** Securely share live data with research and business partners without costly and risky data duplication. This speeds up clinical trial timelines, lowers research costs, improves marketing personalization, creates new opportunities for data monetization and more.

- **Ensure business continuity:** Cultivate resilience with superior disaster recovery that protects critical systems from downtime. Cloud platforms also reduce capital expenditures by shifting to a predictable operational model while supporting strict HIPAA compliance.

- **Leverage data and AI for ROI:** Use your unified data to power AI and machine learning models. This allows you to deploy predictive analytics that lower operational costs, optimize supply chains and accelerate the drug discovery pipeline.

What are the use cases supported by data and AI in healthcare and life sciences?

Data and AI are transforming the entire healthcare and life sciences value chain, from drug discovery to patient care. Here are a few notable ones:

- **Accelerate research:** Speed up drug discovery and development by using AI to identify promising therapeutic targets and optimize clinical trial design. This reduces time-to-market and improves the success rate of bringing new treatments to patients.

- **Improve supply chain effectiveness:** Use predictive analytics to forecast demand for drugs and medical devices, track shipments in real-time and prevent costly stockouts. This enhances resilience, reduces waste and ensures critical products are available when needed.

- **Optimize care delivery:** Deploy predictive models to improve hospital efficiency, such as managing patient flow, optimizing staffing and reducing readmission rates. AI can also identify patients at high risk for acute conditions, so care providers can intervene earlier and improve patient outcomes more easily.

- **Build complete patient/member profiles:** Create comprehensive 360-degree profiles by unifying clinical, claims, genomic and social determinants of health data. This foundational view enables personalized care, more accurate risk stratification, and better member engagement.

- **Enhance commercial effectiveness:** Analyze marketing and sales data to better understand physician prescribing patterns and patient needs. This allows life sciences companies to optimize marketing spend and increase the effectiveness of new product launches.

How is artificial intelligence applied in the healthcare and life sciences industry?

In addition to the use cases above, AI can help increase efficiency, automate normally manual tasks and workflows and provide recommendations and suggestions that can impact patient care and member experiences.

How do I know cloud solutions will protect protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII)?

Snowflake supports leading, globally recognized public sector and commercial security standards to enable compliance and data protection, including of PHI and PII. These certifications include the following:

- HIPAA

- HITRUST CERTIFIED

- FEDRAMP

- SOC2

- GDPR

Learn more on [Snowflake’s security hub](https://www.snowflake.com/en/why-snowflake/snowflake-security-hub/).

What types of industries within healthcare and life sciences are supported by cloud solutions?

Cloud solutions can support an array of subindustries across the healthcare and life sciences sector, including healthcare providers, healthcare payers, life sciences (including medical devices and pharmaceuticals), healthtech and life sciences tech.

How does Snowflake integrate with my existing technical stack?

Snowflake is compatible with many best-of-breed industry solutions, many of which are accessible via native apps and connectors in [Snowflake Marketplace](https://www.snowflake.com/en/product/features/marketplace/).

Can Snowflake be used in environments validated for GxP?

Although regulatory compliance is the customer’s overall responsibility, Snowflake understands that there is some inherited, shared responsibility in those activities with it’s customers. To learn more about how Snowflake supports GxP workloads, please [reference this documentation](https://www.snowflake.com/en/resources/white-paper/snowflake-for-gxp-workloads-compliance-considerations-and-recommended-best-practices/).
